name: AW Browser
description: AW Browser as a Tier-2 (container) app: a headless Chromium instance from OUR prebuilt image (ghcr.io/tekflox/aw-browser, built by this repo's container/ + .github/workflows/build.yml, ported from the legacy monolith tools/browser/), started with --shm-size=1g, exposing its CDP remote-debugging endpoint on port 9223 (entrypoint republishes the internal 127.0.0.1:9222 CDP on 0.0.0.0:9223). Unlike the generic third-party browserless image, ours carries the AW container flags, the CDP platform-override fingerprint daemon, and the Microsoft-core-font set, and is wired to tunnel through AW's cookie proxy and accept the aw-sync extensions. The aw-workspace runtime spawns the container over the host's rootless podman socket and reverse-proxies it at /api/apps/browser/* (ws://.../json/version, driveable by Playwright/CDP clients). Supersedes the fragile Tier-1 in-process prototype (kept in reference/) which hit 64MB /dev/shm, root-sandbox and apt-less-deps walls.

apps.reason: Authentication — this container's Chrome must tunnel through aw-app-proxy's CONNECT proxy, and aw-app-proxy injects/clears its cookies via CDP so it's logged in as the user. See tekflox/aw-app-proxy README.

dependencies.note: Declared for documentation — src/apps/ has no dependency-resolution/enforcement mechanism as of 2026-07-28 (see tekflox/aw-app-proxy README); does not block or auto-install anything yet.
